parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located at the top of the lighter, typically pressed to release gas and ignite the flame.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the gas release mechanism and triggers the ignition when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a metallic cover that protects the ignition area and prevents accidental ignition when closed.
parts.Functional_description: It shields the flame nozzle and wheel, and can be flipped open to allow ignition.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge to open and close over the ignition area.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small steel component that generates sparks when rotated against a flint.
parts.Functional_description: It creates the spark necessary to ignite the gas released by the button.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis when rubbed by the thumb to produce sparks.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, containing the fuel reservoir and supporting all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the fuel, supports the ignition mechanism, and provides a grip for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural base for the entire lighter.
